faq.question: Should I pick Flutter, React Native, or fully native?
faq.answer: It depends on your team, timeline, and platform ambition. We recommend fully native for apps that lean on platform features (Apple Watch, Material You, NFC). Flutter and React Native are great for cross-platform MVPs and most consumer apps. We will recommend the right choice after a short architecture workshop.

faq.question: Do you handle App Store and Play Store submission?
faq.answer: Yes. We manage the whole submission process, including review notes, privacy nutrition labels, Data Safety, signing certificates, and store listing copy. We also set up staged rollouts so you can watch crash-free sessions and roll back if needed.

faq.question: Can you take over an existing app?
faq.answer: Frequently. We do a paid audit first — architecture review, dependency analysis, crash reports, and a one-page plan — then propose a phased engagement. Most rescue projects start with a 2-week stabilization sprint before we touch features.

faq.question: How do you handle ongoing maintenance?
faq.answer: We offer monthly retainer plans that include store updates, dependency upgrades, crash triage, and a small number of feature hours. Most clients keep us on for 6–12 months after launch to keep the app fresh.
